title: Himachal Pradesh State Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2026 passed
summary: The Himachal Pradesh Assembly passed the State Universities (Amendment) Bill, 2026 during the monsoon session. The bill concerns governance and financial oversight of five state universities and awaits the Governor's assent.

title: Three-time attendance system announced for 150 CBSE government schools
summary: The Himachal Pradesh government announced a three-time attendance system for 150 CBSE-affiliated government schools, aimed at improving attendance monitoring and discipline.

title: Himachal Department of Personnel updates
summary: The state's Department of Personnel published new administrative updates in August 2026, including retirement orders, iGOT Karmayogi ranking information and seniority-related notices.

title: GDP growth in Q1 FY 2026-27 reported at 7.8%
summary: India's real GDP growth for Q1 of FY 2026-27 was reported at 7.8%, according to current-affairs reporting based on official national accounts data.

title: August 2026 GST collection reported at ₹1,99,853 crore
summary: Gross GST collection for August 2026 was reported at ₹1,99,853 crore, a 14.8% increase over August 2025.

title: September monsoon forecast below normal
summary: The India Meteorological Department projected September 2026 rainfall below 91% of the long-period average after an August shortfall, according to Reuters reporting.

title: India reports large foreign-exchange inflows
summary: India drew $136.38 billion in foreign-exchange inflows through special schemes, with reported forex reserves reaching $729.33 billion as of August 21, 2026.

title: Air Marshal Sandeep Thareja takes charge as 47th DGAFMS
summary: Air Marshal Sandeep Thareja assumed charge as the 47th Director General Armed Forces Medical Services on 1 September 2026.

title: AVM Shakti Sharma reaches Air Vice Marshal rank
summary: Air Vice Marshal Shakti Sharma became the first woman officer from outside the Medical Branch in the Indian defence services to reach Air Vice Marshal or equivalent rank.
source: Sahi Sarkari Jobs / reported current affairs

title: National Nutrition Week 2026 begins
summary: National Nutrition Week 2026 is observed from 1 to 7 September in India.
